import React from 'react';
import styled from 'styled-components';

const CartPage = () => {
  return (
    <CartContainer>
      
      <Main>
        <CartItems>
          <SectionTitle>MY CART</SectionTitle>
          <Item>
            <ItemImage src="jewellery-image-url" alt="Jewellery" />
            <ItemDetails>
              <ItemName>jewellery name</ItemName>
              <QuantityControl>
                <QuantityButton>-</QuantityButton>
                <Quantity>1</Quantity>
                <QuantityButton>+</QuantityButton>
              </QuantityControl>
            </ItemDetails>
          </Item>
          <Item>
            <ItemImage src="saree-image-url" alt="Saree" />
            <ItemDetails>
              <ItemName>saree name</ItemName>
              <QuantityControl>
                <QuantityButton>-</QuantityButton>
                <Quantity>2</Quantity>
                <QuantityButton>+</QuantityButton>
              </QuantityControl>
            </ItemDetails>
          </Item>
        </CartItems>
        <CartSubtotal>
          <SubtotalTitle>CART SUBTOTAL</SubtotalTitle>
          <SubtotalItem>
            <SubtotalImage src="jewellery-image-url" alt="Jewellery" />
            <SubtotalDetails>
              <SubtotalItemName>jewellery name</SubtotalItemName>
              <SubtotalPrice>Rs.5000000</SubtotalPrice>
            </SubtotalDetails>
          </SubtotalItem>
          <SubtotalItem>
            <SubtotalImage src="saree-image-url" alt="Saree" />
            <SubtotalDetails>
              <SubtotalItemName>saree name</SubtotalItemName>
              <SubtotalPrice>Rs.5000000</SubtotalPrice>
            </SubtotalDetails>
          </SubtotalItem>
          <Total>
            SUBTOTAL: Rs.10000000
          </Total>
          <CheckoutButton>CHECKOUT</CheckoutButton>
        </CartSubtotal>
      </Main>
      
    </CartContainer>
  );
};

export default CartPage;
